<noinclude>Character sheet schema 1 item helper. EQL_CHARACTER_SHEET_ITEM_V1. Supply a canonical item page title, optional tier 0–10, existing numeric item icon ID, reviewed stat lines, optional socket capacity 0–8 and up to eight indexed Exaltations. Optional details contain reviewed descriptive metadata and effect links. Exaltations display only their linked name and effect fields; supplied tiers, icons, stats and other details remain in the page source. This helper computes no game statistics.</noinclude>
